bio: Leave the madding crowd far behind and relax in the hip casual vibe of this trendy Vietnamese eatery. You can expect to sample a fine dining version of characteristic Vietnamese sweet and sour, fermented and spicy flavours. The chef favours local organic produce, an ethos that is reflected in the attractive wine list, rich in natural vintages. The Little Bún noodle shop rustles up gutsy, full-bodied Vietnamese street food....
